scheme_name: Scheme of Assistance for Common Environment Infrastructure: Financial Assistance for Common Environmental Infrastructure Facilities
other_conditions: The applicant must be an industry association, any enterprise (except captive use), or a firm registered under the Societies Act, Trust Act or Companies Act, or a GIDC/Board/Corporation/Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV)/PSU/Municipal Corporation/Nagarpalika/Urban Development Authority.
The proposed project must comply with Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEF) and Gujarat Pollution Control Board (GPCB) regulations.
The project must remain operational for a minimum of 5 years after completion.
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance of up to 40% for general projects and up to 80% for government projects, each capped at ₹50,00,00,000, with total assistance limited to 75% when co‑funded with the GoI.
